column1: # The stages of the implementation of lesson P/01: one possible order, a plan, not a norm. The norms are read in full
# by the rule of the implementer (the implementation README, «Inputs»); the advice is in the README, the checklist — «Done when».
# gate — a list of checks separated by «;», the stage is closed when all of them hold; a check is
# <kind>:<argument>[:<argument>] without spaces: seams:<chapter>:<scenarios|*> — the named scenarios of acceptance/<chapter>/seams.tsv, run
# through the seam adapter by the protocol of the common acceptance README,
# or * for all scenarios of that table; vectors:<package>
# — the vectors of the lesson through the vector command of the implementation; build — the build of the profile; accept:<chapter>:<scenarios|*>
# — the named scenarios of acceptance/<chapter>/scenarios.tsv (comma-separated) or * (all applicable) pass whole; named scenarios run without
# the chapter-wide probes of the stand (the common acceptance README «Instance»), * — the full run of the target; code:* — below. A stage is closed when its
# gate and the gates of all former stages hold.
# code:* — the rows of forms/code-rules.tsv whose stage is this stage or a stage of a smaller n hold, under the closed dictionary of the code checks
# Platform/common/acceptance/forms/code-rules.tsv; the generation cycle checks them, not the acceptance; * is the only argument;
# a row is a data error when neither its stage nor a stage of a larger n has code:* in its gate.
# weight — the relative weight 1–5.
# norms — elements separated by «; »: the sections of the norms, the forms and the packages the stage builds on (read in full, above), and the items of the
# checklists of the norms files of the lesson (the lines - [ ] **P/01.K-MM** of spec/*.norms.md), written P/01.K-MM; each item stands in the norms of exactly
# one stage, the stage at which every subject of the item exists; an item at no stage or at two stages is a data error.
# Columns: n, stage, goal, norms, gate, weight, depends, when.
# depends — the n of former stages, comma-separated, - — none; when — CEL over the keys of the profile, empty — always applicable.
# The one-box daemon work is split into daemon_doors (24 acceptance steps, weight 1), then daemon_copy (51 steps, weight 3).
# Functional gates and engineering group preparation are separate from production qualification: qualification/README.md (judge-only: qualification procedures).
# Its independent qualified workload, finite budgets and storage/time/fault/stream observations are not inferred from these gates; absent bindings stay NotExecuted.
